title: Quality Policy
html:
Quality Policy

Accudyne Systems builds state-of- the-art automation equipment that meets or exceeds the requirements and expectations of our customers.

We actively pursue continuous improvement of our products, processes, operations, and employees to ensure Accudyne equipment:

  • delights our customers
  • comes in on budget
  • is delivered on schedule
  • has fit and finish worthy of the Accudyne Systems, Inc. brand

To that end we are committed to:

  • Understanding the customer needs thru a thorough review of their requirements and regular meetings during the development process.
  • Innovative and thorough engineering using a team approach and multiple critical design reviews.
  • Containment of costs thru fact-based cost estimation and regular cost review meetings.
  • Continuous improvement through documentation of best practices, regular technical exchanges and company-wide lunch & learn meetings.
  • Compliance with the Accudyne Systems Quality Management System.

Our employees are our greatest resource and have the right and responsibility to express their thoughts and concerns at any time to any member of the organization.
